ModMetaData.name: Hide Wires
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Hides the thin power-connection stubs that RimWorld draws from powered buildings to the nearest conduit, for a cleaner base view.
Power conduits themselves — and their own linked wire graphics — are never touched. Only the little connector stub between a building and the grid is hidden.
When the power overlay is up (a conduit designator is selected, or you are in the Power architect tab) the full wiring is always drawn, so you can still plan your layout.
Toggle with the button in the bottom-right overlay row, or with a rebindable hotkey (Options > Keyboard configuration > in-game global). Unbound by default, so it never fights an existing keybind.
Pure rendering change. No saved data, safe to add or remove from an existing save at any time.
Steam Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3784625720 Source: https://github.com/archdukejim/rimworld-hide-wires
